details:
Description

When viewing another user’s badges, you may see badges from a different user if you viewed theirs earlier. The badge list should only show badges for the user whose profile is currently open.

Reproduction Steps

1. Go to a user's profile with badges.

2. Click their badges section, but don't click the text that says "view all".

3. Observe that you see their badges.

4. Back out and now click "view all" text.

5. Observe that you see their badges.

6. Go to a different user's profile and click "view all" on their badges. Specifically make sure to click the text.

7. Should now observe previous user's badges on display.

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
